text:
carl: Quick thread on guardrails for savedview auto-sync with routing changes. Thinking through UX + API + quota safety.

maya: thanks for kicking this off. short goal: let console savedviews follow infra routing when safe, but make rollouts visible & reversible.

diego: two modes: preview-only (shows diffs) and autopilot (applies after checks). autopilot should be opt-in per org and per-route.

zoe: UI: show a tiny chip on savedviews: [auto-sync: preview] or [auto-sync: active], click expands inline diff. prefer no modal if possible.

rahul: telemetry: we need metrics for preview_shown, preview_accepted, auto_apply_attempt, auto_apply_blocked(reason). tag with org_id, route_id, apply_event_id.

ops-bot: ops-bot: deployment scheduled for `route-sync-guard` in us-central1 at 22:10 UTC

carl: API sketch: POST /internal/route-syncs { route_id, savedview_id, dry_run=true, max_token_delta_pct=5 } -> returns { apply_event_id, diffs:[...], estimated_token_delta }.

maya: important: estimated_token_delta must come from sampled recent traffic, not theoretical model sizes. include confidence interval.

diego: guardrail rules proposal: 1) if est token delta > threshold -> block autopilot. 2) if model family changes (e.g., llama2 -> gpt-like) -> require manual review. 3) if eval regression > X -> block.

zoe: for UX, show the cost chip with color: green (<+2%), amber (+2-10%), red (>+10%) and a tooltip with sample size and confidence. also quick 'revert' action visible for 48h.

rahul: telemetry names: route_sync.preview_count, route_sync.preview_accept, route_sync.apply_success, route_sync.apply_failure, route_sync.rollback_initiated. also route_sync.token_delta.p50/p95.

carl: storage: savedview row add columns: auto_sync_state (enum), last_apply_event, last_preview_at. Also a route_sync_events table keyed by apply_event_id.

maya: we should avoid coupling savedview to runtime routing beyond the routebook_id reference. the reconcile job should be idempotent and write audit events.

diego: tests: create a playback harness that replays recent requests and calculates token delta and accuracy delta before applying. tests for idempotency + partial failures.

zoe: tiny mockups incoming: inline diff, cost chip, preview CTA, accept/apply button, small audit flyout. will drop images.

carl: rollout plan idea: feature-flagged -> org opt-in -> 2-week canary on low-traffic routes -> expand. also surface a console banner for admins during canary.

rahul: sampling policy: use a stratified sample across model versions and sequence lengths. record sample size in telemetry and surface it in the diff tooltip.

maya: question: should we allow savedviews to pin model versions independent of route? e.g., user wants a stable eval view.

diego: yes: savedviews can opt-out of auto-sync (pin) and that should be front-and-center. default is opt-out for safety.

carl: follow-ups: zoe mockups, rahul telemetry docs, diego test harness + API RFC, maya coordinate rollout comms. i'll draft the RFC and thread link.

ops-bot: ops-bot: canary deploy finished for `route-sync-guard` (success) :white_check_mark:

maya: love it. extra ask: surface a quick predicted latency change if model swap affects perf (p50 estimate).

rahul: will add route_sync.latency_delta.p50 metric.

carl: ok wrapping up. small deliverables and we'll sync next week. thanks!
